name: filmcraft
description: Let Claude edit your videos in FilmCraft like a professional editor — TikTok, YouTube and gaming montages.
long_description: FilmCraft is a full, open-source video editor. With this extension Claude drives it for you: vertical short-form edits with hooks, jump cuts and captions; gaming montages cut to the beat with punch zooms, shakes and impacts; YouTube edits with B-roll, lower thirds and chapters. It brings ~60 original sound effects, generated royalty-free music (phonk, trap, EDM, chiptune, lo-fi, chill, cinematic) with exact beat grids, CC0/CC BY music and sounds from Openverse, Google Fonts, and one-click editing prompts. Everything runs on your Claude plan — no API key. FilmCraft opens automatically when Claude needs it.
